title: Magnus Felix Ennodius, Epistulae and Dictiones (Letters; Declamations/Speeches) / RU: Эннодий, «Письма», «Речи»
author: Magnus Felix Ennodius (473/4–521), bishop of Pavia
size: 297 letters (9 books), 28 dictiones and opuscula incl. the Panegyric to Theoderic; est. 120k+ words
edition: Vogel, MGH AA 7 (1885), public domain: https://archive.org/details/magnifelicisenn00vogegoog. Hartel, CSEL 6 (1882). Gioanni, Budé (letters)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Эннодий) lists editions only, no Russian translation. Absent from the ancientrome, vostlit and simposium catalogues.
en_evidence: Only the Vita Epiphanii (Cook 1942) and the poems (Mulligan, Poetry of Ennodius, Routledge 2022) found. No English translation of the letters or dictiones (en.wikipedia; Open Library).
other_translations: French: letters Books I–IV (Gioanni, Budé 2006, 2010). German: Panegyric (Rohr, MGH 1995). Italian: Panegyric (2002). Later letter books: none found.
value: A key witness to Ostrogothic Italy, the Laurentian schism, rhetorical schooling and Boethius' circle. Largely inaccessible to non-Latinists.
ai_feasibility: low–medium: notoriously obscure, mannered Latin with textual cruxes. A good showcase for visible disagreement between models and arbitration by the human editor.
pilot_unit: Letters Book V, beyond the published Budé volumes (est. 8–10k words); or the Panegyric to Theoderic (est. 6k words)
